'''August 2001 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, Colorado on 4 August 2001. [[Josh Bader]] won it. It is known from David Jones's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2802">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-07-parker-colorado-8-4-01d2802/ parker-colorado-8-4-01], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 7 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-07-parker-colorado-8-4-01d2802/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Bader]]
